cta.title: Find your place on the field
cta.text: Explore recreational and competitive soccer with Prospector Soccer Club.

purpose.title: A club for our community
purpose.lead: Prospector Soccer Club (PSC) serves Cameron Park, Shingle Springs and Rescue, California, in the El Dorado County foothills.
purpose.statement: Our purpose is to lead in developing young talent and to administer and promote an organized, non-profit, volunteer soccer program for the children of our club’s territory.

vision.title: Room to grow

image.alt: Sunrise across a soccer pitch in the foothills

vision.heading: Our vision
vision.lead: To be a cornerstone of the community: developing players at every level while championing teamwork, respect, discipline, integrity and community.
vision.body: Every player, recreational or competitive, should have room to grow and a lasting love of the game.

image.alt: A soccer field in the California foothills

bullets.text: Give every player a supportive, rewarding place to play, focused on fun, enjoyment and skill at their level of interest and ability.
Create a challenging environment for players who want to reach their full potential.
Foster physical, mental and emotional growth through soccer at all ages and levels.

items.title: Teamwork
items.text: Building trust and communication. We win and lose together.

items.title: Respect
items.text: For the game, teammates, opponents, coaches and officials.

items.title: Discipline
items.text: Following the rules and staying committed.
